question: Determine the top three genres with the most movies rated above 8, and then identify the top four directors who have directed the most films rated above 8 within those genres. List these directors and their respective movie counts.
sql:
-- Verify: show the movies and directors for the top 4 directors
WITH top_genres AS (
    SELECT g.genre
    FROM genre g
    JOIN ratings r ON g.movie_id = r.movie_id
    WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
    GROUP BY g.genre
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT g.movie_id) DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
filtered_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.movie_id
    FROM genre g
    JOIN ratings r ON g.movie_id = r.movie_id
    WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
    AND g.genre IN (SELECT genre FROM top_genres)
)
SELECT n.name, COUNT(DISTINCT fm.movie_id) as movie_count
FROM filtered_movies fm
JOIN director_mapping dm ON fm.movie_id = dm.movie_id
JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
GROUP BY n.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fm.movie_id) >= 2
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, n.name ASC
